item.title: April 2024 Highlights
item.content:encoded:
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9306a1350cbba7f26af0_1*91NPnUlpNBsULjyZBrJF-Q.png)
This past month has been nothing short of transformative and extraordinary for Zebec, our team and our ecosystem, packed with both strategic advancements and a fresh splash of style.
Amidst a whirlwind of change and progress, we've rebranded, started migration of our native token, launched new product features, announced new partnerships and integrations and extended our technological frontiers.
Let's take a moment to revisit these pivotal developments and set the stage for what's next.
## **A New Brand Identity: Introducing Zebec Network**
A significant milestone in Zebec's journey is the unveiling of our new brand identity, which deepens our brand narrative to better reflect the company's growth, our expanding suite of products, and our vision for the future.
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9307a1350cbba7f26af9_1*viHBA7Y53lpjiULi9bU2og.png) *Press enter or click to view image in full size*
Retaining the essence of our origins and our story, we've infused our brand visual identity with elements that symbolize our growth and expansion beyond the original protocol to an interconnected infrastructure network powering our existing and future products. This rebrand is not just a change of logos or colors, but a deeper alignment with our evolving mission and capabilities.
Curious about the company trajectory and rationale for our new look? Dive into our three-part series [The Zebec Evolution](https://medium.com/zebec-protocol/the-zebec-evolution-the-ultimate-abstraction-layer-and-whats-next-940bdf958779) published earlier here on Medium.
To match our new brand and updated narrative, we redesigned our corporate website. It's sleek, it's functional, it goes deeper into who we are and what we do and it's waiting for your feedback. We'd love to hear from you.
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9307a1350cbba7f26afc_1*f8QlktNwAULyKTSNxOJnuQ.png) *Press enter or click to view image in full size[visit zebec.io](https://zebec.io/)*
## **The Next Generation Token Live: $ZBCN**
Following extensive consultations with stakeholders and community, and a vote that showed overwhelming support, we initiated the migration of the original $ZBC token to our Gen 2 Token — $ZBCN. See [zebec.io/migration](http://zebec.io/migration) for details.
$ZBCN is already trading on over 17+ centralized exchanges, including major platforms like crypto.com, OKX, KuCoin, Bithump, byBit and MEXC among them, with more listings underway. Follow official channels for listing announcements.
Migration is progressing as planned, both tokens co-exist through the transition period.
We urge all holders of $ZBC to migrate their tokens promptly before the deadline. Recognizing the need for a seamless transition, we've extended the migration deadline to May 25th. For assistance, our support team is available 24/7 on our Telegram and Discord.
## **The Zebec Network White Paper Released**
We're proud to announce the release of the [Zebec Network White Paper V2](https://zebec-network-whitepaper.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/White+Paper+V2+new.pdf).
## Get elena solovyov's stories in your inbox
Join Medium for free to get updates from this writer.
Subscribe
This comprehensive document outlines our enhanced product suite, advanced technical architecture, ZBCN Tokenomics and our strategic vision for the future. It underscores our commitment to delivering cutting-edge financial solutions.
## **Collaboration and Innovation: Product Upgrades**
A stellar month for our continued product building. April has yielded significant advancements this month. The integration of cross-border remittance processes into our WageLink product has been a focal point, culminating in a grant from the Stellar Foundation. This recognition is a testament to our collaborative efforts and our shared commitment to innovation.
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9307a1350cbba7f26b0a_1*9G560geZdSyvK9Wi8QzdNQ.png) *Press enter or click to view image in full size*
## The Zebec Instant: **New Features from April and New Path for the Next-Gen Card**
In April, our card team enhanced the Zebec Instant Card with several exciting updates. We added 11 new tokens, featuring popular memes from the Base and Ethereum ecosystems, and forged partnerships with Solana-based projects like SolChat and SolBank. Additionally, we expanded our currency options to include the British Pound, Canadian Dollar, and Chinese Yuan.
If you missed our cool new card ad — "Zebec Instant: Your Passport to the World" watch it [HERE](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KJqkRpfeLvw)
Important: We have started on the complete overhaul of our card program as we prepare with the upcoming launch of our point of service terminal and in line with the on-going upgrades to our overall payments infrastructure and off ramps offerings.
Curious to know more about DePin + Payments? Here is a brief primer on it on X(formerly Twitter) [here](https://x.com/Zebec_HQ/status/1783142329605554333) and come back next month to read our May recap article here with news about our PoS terminal launch!
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9307a1350cbba7f26b31_1*Pt0n7XDyqSLGOrmh6gld-A.png) *Press enter or click to view image in full size*
## **Benefits for Node Holders and Community**
We have seen significant interest from various projects and communities eager to integrate with Zebec Instant. These integrations often serve as a boon to both ecosystems, expanding our reach and introducing Zebec and our products to new audiences and as well enhancing the practical utility of the tokens and memecoins involved.
Our priority remains delivering value to our Node and ZBCN holders. Consequently, our card partnerships and integration contracts include allocations of partner tokens for airdrops to our community. With over 35 partnerships, we have distributed close to $1M in direct rewards and tokens to Node holders, the top 1000 $ZBCN wallets, and the broader community.
More airdrops and exclusive rewards for Node holders are to be announced soon!!
## **Insightful Conversations: 'The Future of Money' Series Cont'd**
Launched in March, our 'Future of Money' series has consistently brought unique perspectives to our audience through insightful interviews and discussions with key industry figures. In April, we hosted a diverse group of participants including investors, partners, clients, collaborators, and industry experts. Listen to the 'Future of Money' interviews featuring executives from JP Morgan, KBW, Areas, Mural, Foley & Lardner, Kraken, and NEAR, among others.
![Image](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68d3b37780071b176225aeb9/68db9307a1350cbba7f26b0d_1*Yw0wOuwl4GMcHX8WvSWIZw.png) *Press enter or click to view image in full sizeListen to our "Future of Money" Series here*
We explored a wide array of topics and disciplines, including mergers and acquisitions and capital markets with leading global investment fund executives, digital assets and trends in digital asset adoption with traditional financiers; modern payment flows and cross-border remittances with global payments experts, and the regulatory frameworks for digital assets across the world with a top crypto law firm.
Looking ahead, we have an exciting lineup of new guests and topics poised to further enrich our community's understanding of the broader industry trends and landscape.
## **See you in Austin!**
After making a splash at Token2024 in Dubai, Zebec is gearing up for the upcoming Consensus in Austin. We look forward to sharing more insights and developments there.
April has been a monumental month at Zebec, filled with groundbreaking developments and strategic advancements. As we continue to innovate and grow, we invite you to stay connected and engage with us. Your insights and feedback are invaluable as we shape the future of finance together.

item.title: Fintech Fusion: The Role of M&A in Zebec’s Vision
item.content:encoded:
In the dynamic world of fintech, strategic moves often dictate the pace of innovation and adoption. Zebec, a frontrunner in blockchain-based payments, cards and payroll solutions, has recently made significant strides through its investment arm, [Payroll Growth Partners](https://payrollgrowthpartners.com/) (PGP).
The series of acquisitions and product launches under PGP's banner align perfectly with Zebec's overarching vision of modernizing financial ecosystems. This unique approach not only marks Zebec's successful real-life application for its stream finance technology, but also sets it apart in the crypto payments landscape.
Over the past year, PGP's acquisition of PayBridge and School Payroll Services (SPS) have expanded Zebec's payroll segment and its integration with traditional payroll systems in the United States. PayBridge, a leader in payroll and HCM solutions, processes over $300M in payroll volume annually, underscoring the significant scale of this integration. Furthermore, acquiring SPS paved the way to creating a premier payroll service for educators and administrators across more than a hundred schools nationwide.
### **Traditional payroll tech upgrades and seamless integration**
Following these M&As, PGP has made significant investments in technology upgrades and operational efficiencies of the acquired payroll service companies. These enhancements result in time and cost savings for both the companies and the clients they serve. More crucially, the modernization of the tech stack introduces new financial tools to the workforce in client companies. These tools include early wage access, financial tracking and management tools, direct payment card spending via the payroll app [WageLink](https://wagelink.io/). Additionally, through partnerships and direct integrations with [Circle](https://www.circle.com/en/) and [Stellar](https://stellar.org/), WageLink will enable employees to receive a portion of their salary in digital currency (USDC) and send it to families abroad swiftly and cost effectively in USDC or XLM.
Such integration of traditional payroll systems with web3 layers is a masterstroke in strategic value. This fusion transcends technological achievement; acting as a gateway to a more versatile and efficient financial ecosystem. It offers significant benefits to investors, the crypto industry, and global economic participants by creating a seamless interface between conventional payroll processing and the innovative efficiency of blockchain technology.
### **IRL: the growing adoption, ease of use and cross border payments**
The leap into blockchain-based, real-time payroll systems is set to revolutionize the market. With its innovations, Zebec is not just changing how payroll is processed or accessed but is also unlocking new investment opportunities and avenues for market growth. This transformative move is pivotal in deploying practical, real-world applications of blockchain technology in everyday financial transactions.

Zebec's strategic acquisitions have expanded and diversified its ecosystem, integrating new users into its blockchain-based infrastructure. Through the acquisitions of PayBridge and School Payroll Services, Zebec has successfully added 12,000 real-world users to its ecosystem. Moreover, the company expects continued growth in the user base of its next-gen technology — driven both organically and through additional M&A — thereby scaling adoption and expanding market reach.
Zebec's approach extends beyond domestic borders, encompassing the international payroll domain with efficient, blockchain-driven, real-time payroll solutions. These are particularly relevant for hourly employees in developing countries and participants in a gig economy. At its core, Zebec's strategy is inclusive. By bringing traditionally unbanked populations into the financial system, Zebec is not only broadening its market reach but also solidifying its position as a pioneer in the financial technology space. This approach not only appeals to socially-conscious investors but aids in creating a more equitable financial landscape.
### **Shaping the Future**
Through these initiatives, Zebec is not only transforming how payroll is processed but also how financial transactions are perceived and executed in the blockchain era. This fusion of traditional payroll services with modern fintech innovation places Zebec at the forefront of the financial revolution, primed to shape the future of money and payments.
In conclusion, PGP's strategic mergers and acquisitions extend beyond mere growth tactics; they are rather vital catalysts in realizing Zebec's vision. These steps are also instrumental in amplifying the market value and practical utility of ZBCN token, while setting a new standard in the fintech industry.
Zebec's mission is not just about futuristic technology — it's about building a future where finance is more accessible, efficient, and inclusive.
**About Zebec:**
Zebec is pioneering real world applications of streaming finance technology in payroll, financial transactions, investments and more. Founded in 2021, with investments by Circle, Coinbase, Solana Ventures, Breyer Capital, Republic, and Lightspeed Venture Partners among others. Zebec today services hundreds of web2 and web3 companies, runs thousands of continuous payment streams and powers next generation payroll services. In effect, across its suite of real-time payroll, payments and on-and-off ramps via the Zebec cards, Zebec is the crypto payments superapp, integrating the blockchain into everyday lives.
